CNN on Instagram: "ABC has just canceled its upcoming season of "The Bachelorette" after TMZ released a 2023 video Thursday morning showing the Season 22 star and "The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives" cast member Taylor Frankie Paul throwing objects and yelling at her former boyfriend Dakota Mortensen. Read more at the link in our bio."
content.text: ABC has just canceled its upcoming season of "The Bachelorette" after TMZ released a 2023 video Thursday morning showing the Season 22 star and "The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives" cast member Taylor Frankie Paul throwing objects and yelling at her former boyfriend Dakota Mortensen. CNN has not independently verified the video's authenticity.Read more at the link in our bio.They were fine with airing it until the video went viral. It wasn’t her actions they had a problem with.But Epstein videos are okThe video is from 2023, she was arrested, pled guilty, and served the agreed upon sentence. The arrest footage was literally part of the pilot episode of Secret Lives of Mormon Wives (from Hulu, which also aired on ABC). Timing of its release is pretty sus.Nonsense. Nothing is done with the Epstein files but they take swift action if a woman dares to abuse a man. I'm confused 😕 😐Im shocked she was picked for Bachelorette, she was drama on her other showDomestic violence and child abuse never gets the pass.Reactive Abuse.Provocation — A tactic where an abuser pushes a victim until they lash out, then uses that reaction as "proof" of the victim's instability..Manipulation — The goal is to shift the blame and control the narrative in the eyes of the public..Timing & Sabotage.Post-Separation Abuse — Releasing old footage during a victim's milestone (like a new relationship or career success) is a common power play..Impact — Using social media as a weapon to damage the victim's reputation and mental health..Psychology.Systemic Bias — Observers often focus on the visible reaction rather than the invisible, long-term harassment that caused it..Education — Understanding trauma responses is key to not falling for an abuser's public manipulation.Shame on abc for promoting female domestic violence but criticizing male domestic violenceCNN reporting on ABC using TMZ footageI CANT BELIEVE PEOPLE WATCH THIS KIND OF STUPID SHOW, NO WONDER YOU SEE WHAT YOU SEE IN TODAYS SOCIETY. 😒But why is she facing consequences for something that she already dealt with, rehabilitated from and has moved past. Shes was already punished. @abc shame on you. You very well knew of her record when casting her .Abuse has no gender! Great decision 👏🏿I just don’t understand why they ever dangled the carrot in the first place then. We all know Taylor’s history. She made a mistake and can’t have that held against her forever. Give the girl a break!
